> `missionctl guide lanes` as this release renders it, with no installation behind it. Where this file and your server differ, the server is right.
> Lane tables list every lane profile the release declares; your server binds some of them.

# Lanes: where an agent runs

A lane is one harness that runs agent cognition; a lane profile is one placement of it. A manifest names a lane profile in `environment.lane`; a node may overlay it. Only the lanes listed here are bound on this installation: a manifest that names another is refused.

Choose by what the node needs, in this order:

1. The workflow system: the lane must run the node's `behavior` (topic `workflows`).
2. The model: the lane must route the Model Profile's vendor (topic `models`).
3. The capabilities: the lane must support each item kind you attach, and each capability must support the lane (topic `capabilities`).
4. The controls you will need during the run: how the lane delivers an instruction, an interrupt, a cancel and a fork (topic `control`).

Prefer a qualified lane. An unqualified lane is implemented without a recorded qualification and is admitted only where the installation allows it.

| Lane profile | Placement | Qualified | Workflow systems | Vendors | Item kinds |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `claude_agent_sdk` | worker_hosted | no | StageGraph, GoalDirected | anthropic | skill_bundle, mcp_server, hook_script, subagent_profile, environment_kit |
| `claude_cloud` | cloud | no | unqualified: StageGraph, GoalDirected | anthropic | skill_bundle, mcp_server, hook_script, subagent_profile |
| `claude_managed` | cloud | no | StageGraph, GoalDirected | anthropic | skill_bundle, mcp_server |
| `codex` | worker_hosted | no | StageGraph, GoalDirected | openai | skill_bundle, mcp_server, hook_script, subagent_profile, environment_kit |
| `codex_agents` | cloud | no | StageGraph, GoalDirected | openai | skill_bundle, mcp_server |
| `codex_cloud` | cloud | no | unqualified: StageGraph, GoalDirected | openai | skill_bundle |
| `cursor_cloud` | cloud | no | StageGraph, GoalDirected | anthropic, openai | skill_bundle, mcp_server, hook_script, subagent_profile, environment_kit |
| `cursor_local` | worker_hosted | no | StageGraph, GoalDirected | anthropic, openai | skill_bundle, mcp_server, hook_script, subagent_profile, environment_kit |
| `deep_agents` (default) | worker_hosted | yes | StageGraph, GoalDirected; unqualified: ParallelSwarm, EvaluatorOptimizer | anthropic, openai | skill_bundle, mcp_server, tool, subagent_profile, middleware, sandbox_profile |

Features of `deep_agents`, by namespace (`feature:<namespace>.<name>`):
- `deep_agents`: filesystem, bash, todo_list, context_editing, summarization, call_limits
- `openai`: web_search, file_search, code_interpreter, compaction, moderation
- `anthropic`: prompt_caching, web_search, web_fetch, code_execution, bash, memory, clear_tool_uses, compaction
- not available: `deep_agents.filesystem_permissions` (needs_upgrade), `deep_agents.memory` (planned), `deep_agents.rubric` (planned), `deep_agents.code_interpreter` (needs_upgrade), `openai.auto_mode` (needs_upgrade), `openai.model_router` (needs_upgrade), `anthropic.text_editor` (planned)

In the table, a name alone is `native`; a prefix marks the weaker verdicts (`emulated`, `unqualified`). What is absent is unsupported.

Read one lane in full with `missionctl describe lane:PROFILE`: its `controls`, `delivery_semantics`, `time_travel`, hook events, approval modes, subagent field support and `model_routes`. List the lanes with `missionctl search --facet lane`; narrow a search to one lane with `missionctl search QUERY --lane PROFILE`.

A feature is provider-specific behaviour a node switches on in `environment.provider_options.<lane profile>`: `lane_features` by name, or `model_tools` by vendor then name. Read one feature's configuration schema, status and what it needs with `missionctl describe feature:ID`. A feature whose status is not `available` is refused when selected.
